methods.name: Pocket2Mol
methods.title: Pocket2Mol: Efficient Molecular Sampling Based on 3D Protein Pockets
methods.summary: Adds ligand atoms, coordinates and bonds sequentially with an equivariant environment encoder.

methods.name: ResGen
methods.title: ResGen is a pocket-aware 3D molecular generation model based on parallel multiscale modelling
methods.summary: Parallel atom and residue scales encode the pocket environment for molecular construction.

methods.name: Apo2Mol
methods.title: Apo2Mol: 3D Molecule Generation via Dynamic Pocket-Aware Diffusion Models
methods.summary: Joint ligand and holo-like pocket generation from an apo structural condition.

methods.name: FragGen
methods.title: FragGen: towards 3D geometry reliable fragment-based molecular generation
methods.summary: Fragment-wise construction separates geometry handling from the molecular encoder.

methods.name: PMDM
methods.title: A dual diffusion model enables 3D molecule generation and lead optimization based on target pockets
methods.summary: Local and global geometric kernels condition ligand generation on the protein.

methods.name: PILOT
methods.title: PILOT: Equivariant diffusion for pocket conditioned de novo ligand generation with multi-objective guidance via importance sampling
methods.summary: Equivariant diffusion combines pocket conditioning with pretraining and optional property guidance.

methods.name: PocketFlow
methods.title: PocketFlow is a data-and-knowledge-driven structure-based molecular generative model
methods.summary: Chemical knowledge constrains stepwise atom and bond generation in a pocket.

methods.name: DrugGPS
methods.title: Learning Subpocket Prototypes for Generalizable Structure-based Drug Design
methods.summary: Subpocket prototypes connect local protein environments to molecular motifs.

methods.name: VoxBind
methods.title: Structure-based drug design by denoising voxel grids
methods.summary: Atomic density grids use conditional Langevin sampling followed by a voxel denoiser.

methods.name: SculptDrug
methods.title: SculptDrug: A Spatial Condition-Aware Bayesian Flow Model for Structure-based Drug Design
methods.summary: A surface-aware boundary block and hierarchical encoder provide spatial conditions.

methods.name: PIDiff
methods.title: PIDiff: Physics informed diffusion model for protein pocket-specific 3D molecular generation
methods.summary: Binding-energy principles augment geometric pocket-conditioned diffusion.

methods.name: YuelDesign
methods.title: A diffusion-based framework for designing molecules in flexible protein pockets
methods.summary: Continuous coordinates and discrete ligand types are modeled jointly with an equivariant complex encoder.

methods.name: SeFMol
methods.title: Steering semi-flexible molecular diffusion model for structure-based drug design with reinforcement learning
methods.summary: Reinforcement learning steers ligand denoising and property-conditioned conformation exploration.
